definitions.gloss: to cut down, to strike down
definitions.explanation: To kill by cutting with a sword.
To ruthlessly eliminate or get rid of something.
In mathematics, to drop digits below a certain decimal place.

notes:
{切|き}り{捨|す}てる is a compound verb combining ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to discard), with meanings spanning from violent to mathematical.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle

THREE MEANINGS:
1. Historical: to cut down/kill with a sword
2. Modern: to ruthlessly discard or abandon
3. Mathematical: to truncate/round down

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}てる: to eliminate waste
- ⟦{小数点以下|しょうすうてんいか}→小数点以下：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}てる: to truncate decimals
- ⟦{端数|はすう}→端数：23501_hasuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}てる: to round down fractions

CONTRAST:
- ⟦{切|き}り{上|あ}げる→切り上げる：06979_kiriageru⟧: to round up (math)
- ⟦{四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}→四捨五入：15694_shishagonyuu⟧: to round (up/down at 5)

HISTORICAL:
{切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦{御免|ごめん}→御免：00072_gomen⟧: the right of samurai to kill commoners.
